selection_rule: Among candidates with a mean chronological-validation false-positive rate no greater than 5%, maximize mean fault-detection F1 across equally weighted simulated scenarios; break ties with lower false-positive rate and shorter detection delay.
scope_note: The detector uses only current and past Light readings. Occupied-dark and unoccupied-lit counterfactuals are excluded because they are policy or behavior changes, not observable sensor-health labels.
